# emem

> emem is a signed, content-addressed spatial memory for AI agents — every place-time on Earth resolves to a verifiable fact, read over MCP or REST, no keys, every answer an ed25519 receipt verifiable offline.

This is the full flat catalog: enough to use emem from one fetch, without crawling.
For the spec structure see https://emem.dev/llms.txt.

WHAT IT IS
An LLM asked what is at a place will usually guess. emem is the missing handle: every
patch of ground gets a 64-bit address (cell64, ~9.55 m at the equator), and a fact is
keyed by Cell × Band × Tslot. The responder signs each fact over the BLAKE3 of its
canonical CBOR, so the same content id returns byte-identical bytes from any conformant
responder and any client verifies the receipt offline. emem is a protocol, not a single
endpoint. Reads need no auth. Empty is a signed answer, not a 404 — absence is attested,
so an agent should surface "no answer here" and not retry.

DATA MODEL
  Fact     :: Cell × Band × Tslot → {value, unit, provenance, fact_cid}
  Receipt  :: Request → {fact_cids, responder_pubkey_b32, signature}
  cell64   = b1024(lat[21] · lng[22]), pitch ~9.55 m at the equator
  CID      = base32-nopad-lowercase(blake3(canonical_cbor(fact)), 32B)
  sig      = ed25519(blake3(request_id | served_at | primitive | cells | fact_cids))

TRUST MODEL (one line)
  hash = blake3; signature = ed25519; encoding = canonical/deterministic CBOR; reads need
  no auth, L2 writes need an attester key; identical canonical facts produce identical CIDs
  across responders; verify any receipt offline with the responder pubkey from
  https://emem.dev/.well-known/emem.json.

CONNECT
  MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0, Streamable HTTP) : https://emem.dev/mcp
  OpenAPI 3.1 (full REST contract)    : https://emem.dev/openapi.json
  Agent card                          : https://emem.dev/v1/agent_card  (alias /agent.json)
  Discovery descriptor                : https://emem.dev/.well-known/mcp.json
  Quickstart playbook                 : https://emem.dev/docs/quickstart.html
  MCP config (Claude/Cursor/Cline/VSCode):
    { "mcpServers": { "emem": { "url": "https://emem.dev/mcp" } } }
  Recommended first tool: emem_ask — intent-routed; one call resolves place → recall →
  applicable algorithms.

PRIMITIVES (when to use each)
  ask              POST /v1/ask            free-text question (+place) → route → recall → algorithms, one call
  locate           POST /v1/locate         place name or lat/lng → cell64 + bbox; call before recall, never fabricate a cell64
  recall           POST /v1/recall         cell × bands → signed facts; auto-fetches + signs on a miss
  recall_many      POST /v1/recall_many    up to 256 cells × bands → per-cell facts + per-cell receipts
  recall_polygon   POST /v1/recall_polygon region/polygon × bands → per-cell facts + area aggregate
  trajectory       POST /v1/trajectory     one cell × band × [from,to] → per-tslot time series
  find_similar     POST /v1/find_similar   cell or embedding × k → top-K cosine neighbours (Tessera 128-D by default)
  compare          POST /v1/compare        two cells × family → similarity score
  diff             POST /v1/diff           one cell × two tslots × bands → per-band delta
  state            POST /v1/state          dense signed state vector: one encoder, or the full 1792-D cube
  state_diff       POST /v1/state_diff     state delta between two tslots at one cell
  hunt             POST /v1/hunt           event × region → ranked hotspots (12 events)
  eudr_dds         POST /v1/eudr_dds       plots × cut-off → Annex II due-diligence envelope (EU 2023/1115)
  attest           POST /v1/attest         signed write of a new fact (needs an attester key)
  verify_receipt   POST /v1/verify_receipt a receipt → {valid, signer}; or verify in-browser at /verify
  memory search    POST /v1/memory/search  BGE-768 semantic search over the writable agent-memory layer
  memory contradictions POST /v1/memory_contradictions  multi-attester contradiction scoring per band kind
  memory bundle    POST /v1/memory_bundle  signed content-addressed bundle of facts (memb:<bundle_cid>)

HUNTER EVENTS (12)
  algal_bloom, deforestation, flood_extent, wildfire, urban_heat_island, methane_plume,
  landslide, drought, soil_salinity, crop_stress, water_turbidity, oil_slick.
  The responder samples up to 32 cells from the region (8 for slow primary bands such as
  MODIS LST), recalls the primary scalar plus any gate band (e.g. NDWI > 0 for over-water
  phenomena), and ranks the cells; a Tessera embedding rerank fires when ≥3 cells carry a
  geotessera vector. oil_slick has no algorithm registered yet — the responder returns
  status: not_yet_implemented rather than fabricate a value.

FORECAST & SOLVE
  heat_solve, wave_solve : closed-form 2-D physics solvers over a recalled stack.
  jepa_predict           : closed-form NDVI AR(2) forecast.
  jepa_predict_v2        : Tessera dynamics that short-circuits to an identity baseline; the
                           receipt carries untrained_baseline. It is not a trained model.

FOUNDATION ENCODERS (4)
  Clay v1.5 (1024-D), Prithvi-EO-2.0-300M-TL (1024-D), Tessera (128-D), Galileo.
  Tessera ships annual vintages 2017–2024 (2024 default). Galileo's S2 modality is wired
  today; the multimodal scaffold (S1, DEM, …) exists but only S2 is connected.

TYPED EDGES (connect & evolve)
  Facts link through typed edges: disagrees_with, supersedes, relates_to. Multi-attester
  contradiction scoring and a refinement loop let the corpus improve over time.

CANONICAL COUNTS
  80 MCP tools (10 core, 70 extended) · 92 documented /v1 paths (95 in OpenAPI) ·
  159 algorithms · 122 materializer-wired band names across 42 cube slots · 46 source
  schemes · 27 topics · 4 foundation encoders · 7 MCP resources + 3 URI templates ·
  16 crates · v0.0.9.

CATALOGS (machine-readable)
  /v1/manifests          registry manifest CIDs (bands, algorithms, sources, topics)
  /v1/bands              band ontology, dims, tempo, materializer status
  /v1/algorithms         159 composition recipes
  /v1/topics             27 topic routes used by ask
  /v1/materializers      wire-stable list of auto-materializing bands
  /v1/data_availability  per-band kind / tempo / history window
  /v1/coverage_matrix    has_materializer, facts_count, last_attested

DISCOVERY
  /.well-known/mcp.json        MCP server descriptor
  /.well-known/emem.json       manifest CIDs + responder pubkey
  /.well-known/agent-card.json A2A agent card
  /agents.md                   integration guide for consumer agents
  /skills.md                   composed-recipe cookbook
  /reference                   the read surface (client setup, endpoint tables, hunter table)
  /whitepaper.md               architecture + math
  /docs/quickstart.html        step-by-step playbook
  /docs/errors.html            structured error codes + resolution hints
  /docs/gallery                live coverage map + per-place scenes + protocol diagrams
  /demos                       runnable end-to-end demos
  /humans                      interactive console; every /v1/* call prints in a live log pane

RULES FOR AGENTS
  1. Resolve a place name with /v1/locate before /v1/recall. Don't fabricate cell64s.
  2. Cite receipt.fact_cids[0] (13-char prefix). Never invent a CID.
  3. Surface Fact::Absence as "no answer here", not a missing field. Don't retry.
  4. Treat 404 cid_not_found as "call /v1/recall first to materialise".
  5. Verify receipts offline before quoting them (see /skills.md § verify-receipt-offline).
  6. Mention responder_pubkey_b32 once per session so the user knows who signed.

HONEST LIMITS (skip emem, use the paired tool)
  "is it raining right now in X"        → met.no / NOAA / Open-Meteo (real-time / sub-daily)
  "forecast 6 months out for X"          → out of horizon (JEPA v2 short-circuits past ~2 weeks)
  "sub-metre building footprint at X"    → Planet / Maxar (10 m is emem's native pitch)
  "land / carbon-credit price at X"      → market data services (emem signs Earth observation, not economics)
  "live air-quality sensor reading at X" → PurpleAir / OpenAQ (cams.* is global model output, not a sensor)
  "stream the latest tile of <band>"     → upstream STAC API (emem is snapshot-at-tslot, not streaming)
  "verify EUDR Article 9(1)(b) legality" → partner legality module (land tenure / FPIC is not EO)
